title: Big Bold Summer Edition Lemon & Peach 100ml Shortfill E-liquid
description: Big Bold Summer Edition Lemon & Peach is a true taste of summer, with rich, juicy, sun-ripened peaches lifted with the sweet, sharp tang of fresh, zesty lemons. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods and sub-ohm tanks.
